players.bio: Andrew Davey (born 29 November 1991) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays as a second-row forward for the Parramatta Eels in the NRL. He previously played for the Parramatta Eels and Manly Sea Eagles in the National Rugby League.

Bailey George Simonsson (born 18 February 1998) is a New Zealand Māori international rugby league footballer who plays as a winger for the Parramatta Eels in the NRL. Simonsson played for the Canberra Raiders in the Harold Matthews Cup (under 16s), later joining the Canterbury-Bankstown Bulldogs to play S. G. Ball Cup (under 18s) and NYC (under 20s) until 2017.

Bryce Cartwright (born 15 November 1994) is an Australian rugby league footballer who plays as a second-row and lock for the Parramatta Eels in the NRL. He is also well known for his outspoken stance as an opponent to vaccination and has been dubbed a 'poster boy' for the anti-vax movement. Cartwright previously played for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL.

Clinton Gutherson (born 9 September 1994) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays as a fullback, centre, wing and five-eighth for the Parramatta Eels in the NRL. He previously played for the Manly Warringah Sea Eagles in the National Rugby League, and has played for the City Origin side and the Prime Minister's XIII.

Haze Dunster (born 1 March 1999) is a professional rugby league footballer who plays as a winger for the Parramatta Eels in the National Rugby League. Dunster graduated from Parramatta's Jersey Flegg team in the Intrust Super Premiership with the Wentworthville Magpies. In 2019, Dunster re-signed with Parramatta until the end of the 2020 season.

J'maine Dale Hopgood (born 11 May 1999) is a professional rugby league footballer who plays as a lock for the Parramatta Eels in the NRL. He previously played for the Penrith Panthers in the National Rugby League.

Jirah Momoisea (born 2 September 1998) is a New Zealand professional rugby league footballer who plays as a prop and second-row forward for the Parramatta Eels in the NRL. Momoisea was born in Auckland, New Zealand. He played his junior rugby league for St Paul's College, before being signed by the Melbourne Storm.

Joey Lussick (born 28 December 1995) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays as a hooker for the Parramatta Eels in the NRL. He previously played for the Manly Warringah Sea Eagles and the Parramatta Eels in the NRL, and the Salford Red Devils and St Helens (Heritage No. 1268) in the Super League.

Joshua Hodgson (born 31 October 1989) is an English rugby league footballer who plays as a hooker for the Parramatta Eels in the NRL. He has played for the England Knights, England and Great Britain at international level. Hodgson began his senior club career with Hull F.C. after progressing through their Academy system, making his first team début in 2009.

Junior Paulo (born 20 November 1993) is a Samoa international rugby league footballer who plays as a prop for the Parramatta Eels in the NRL. He played his junior football for the Ashcroft Stallions and the Cabramatta Two Blues, and attended renowned rugby league school Ashcroft High School before being signed by the Parramatta Eels. Paulo played for the Eels NYC team in 2012 and 2013.

Makahesi Makatoa (born 30 January 1993) is a Cook Islands international rugby league footballer who plays as a prop or lock forward for the Parramatta Eels in the NRL. He previously played for Featherstone Rovers in the RFL Championship.

Matt Doorey (born 27 June 2000) is a professional rugby league footballer who plays as a second-row forward for the Canterbury-Bankstown Bulldogs in the NRL. Doorey made his first grade debut in round 14 of the 2020 NRL season for Canterbury-Bankstown against the Wests Tigers, scoring a try on debut in a 29–28 loss at Bankwest Stadium.

Mitch Rein (born 26 April 1990) is an Australian rugby league footballer who plays as a hooker for the Parramatta Eels in the National Rugby League (NRL). Rein began playing rugby league in his hometown of Kiama for the Kiama Knights, working his way up the junior ranks before signing for the Illawarra Steelers to play in their junior competitions, Harold Matthews Cup and S.G. Ball Cup.

Mitchell Moses ( born 16 September 1994) is a Lebanon international rugby league footballer who plays as a five-eighth and halfback for the Parramatta Eels in the National Rugby League (NRL). He previously played for the Wests Tigers in the National Rugby League, and has also played for the Australian Prime Minister's XIII and World All Stars sides.

Ofahiki Ogden (born 6 June 1996) is a New Zealand rugby league footballer who plays as a prop for the Parramatta Eels in the NRL. Ogden made his NRL debut for Canterbury-Bankstown in round 16 of the 2018 NRL season against the Newcastle Knights.

Reagan Campbell-Gillard (born 27 July 1993), also known by the nicknames of "Reggie" or "RCG", is a professional rugby league footballer who plays as a prop for the Parramatta Eels in the NRL. He has played for Fiji and Australia at international level. He has played for the Penrith Panthers in the National Rugby League.

Ryan Matterson (born 13 October 1994) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays as a second-row, five-eighth and centre for the Parramatta Eels in the NRL. He previously played for the Sydney Roosters, with whom he won the 2018 NRL Grand Final and the Wests Tigers in the National Rugby League. Matterson has also played for the City Origin side.

Samuel Loizou (born 25 December 2002) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays as a winger for the Parramatta Eels in the NRL. In 2019, Loizou represented the Australian Schoolboys being the youngest player in the squad. Loizou was also a part of Parramatta's SG Ball team at 16 years of age winning their best and fairest award in 2019.

Sean Russell (born 27 May 2002) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays as a winger or fullback for the Parramatta Eels in the NRL. Russell was born in Windsor, New South Wales, Australia. He played his junior rugby league for the Rouse Hill Rhinos.

Shaun Lane (born 29 November 1994) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays as second-row forward for the Parramatta Eels in the NRL. He previously played for the Canterbury-Bankstown Bulldogs, New Zealand Warriors and the Manly Sea Eagles in the National Rugby League.

Viliami Penisini (born, 31 July 2002) is a Tonga international rugby league footballer who plays as a centre for the Parramatta Eels in the NRL. He played his junior football for the Rouse Hill Rhinos.

Wiremu Greig (born 12 November 1999) is a New Zealand professional rugby league footballer who plays as a prop for the Parramatta Eels in the NRL, and the New Zealand Māori at international level. Greig began his rugby league career playing for Northlands in the 2017 New Zealand Rugby League National Championships before being signed by the North Queensland Cowboys at age 17.
